description: Microchip MCP6001 — single rail-to-rail I/O op-amp, 1.8-6V supply, 1 MHz GBW, 100µA quiescent current. SOT-23-5 package. The go-to jellybean op-amp for low-voltage single-supply designs.
name: mcp6001
watch_out_for: Gain-bandwidth product 1 MHz — not for audio or high-speed. Input bias current ~1pA typical. Phase reversal does NOT occur when input exceeds common-mode range. Output swings within ~25mV of rails. Stable at unity gain with 100pF load.
